summary: Fairbanks police report two arrests from Thursday: a theft on the 1400 block of South Cushman Street and a driving-under-the-influence arrest at the Steese Highway and College Road. No new criminal case had been opened at the Fairbanks court, or at the Nenana, Healy or Delta Junction courts, at the time of reading. The Alaska Court System's weekly charges report for Nov. 20 to Nov. 26 counts 37 criminal filings at Fairbanks and none at the three rural courts; the counts below are the report's own. One Fairbanks case the court's public case database serves in full, 4FA-26-02342CR, filed Nov. 24, does not appear in that report.

entries.title: Theft arrest: Alyssa Faith Morry
body: Alyssa Faith Morry, 29, was arrested on a charge of theft in the fourth degree - taking property worth less than $250 - recorded by police as a misdemeanor. The 1400 block of South Cushman Street, Fairbanks, Nov. 26 at 4:28 p.m.; Fairbanks Police.
No court case has been opened in connection with this arrest.

entries.title: DUI arrest: Gregory Christopher Burt Chico
body: Gregory Christopher Burt Chico, 25, was arrested on a charge of driving under the influence of alcohol or a controlled substance, recorded by police as a misdemeanor. The 100 block of the Steese Highway at College Road, Fairbanks, Nov. 26 at 12:55 p.m.; Fairbanks Police.
No court case has been opened in connection with this arrest.

entries.title: Court hearings set in Fairbanks for Friday
body: Six arraignments are set for 8:30 a.m. Friday at the Fairbanks Courthouse, in cases 4FA-26-02320CR, 02324CR, 02325CR, 02326CR, 02327CR and 02336CR.
Three bail hearings are set for 10:00 a.m. the same day before Judge Ben Seekins, in cases 4FA-26-02319CR, 02331CR and 02332CR.
An arraignment set for Friday in case 4FA-26-02337CR has been vacated. Arraignment in that case is now set for Dec. 1.
